run_g2p_word_to_phoneme: run the script to convert words from stdin into phoneme sequences using g2p_en
run_g2p_compact_phones: run the script with --compact flag to strip numeric stress markers from phonemes
review_g2p_main: review the main function that reads words from stdin and outputs phoneme sequences
summarize_g2p_wrd_to_phn: summarize the script that maps words to phonemes with optional compact mode for stress removal
test_g2p_cache: test the word-to-phoneme caching dictionary that avoids redundant g2p lookups across input lines
